title: Emberrr
tagline: Emberrr.xyz connects early-stage Web3 builders with vetted experts to accelerate their development
description:
emberrr.xyz connects stealth-stage Web3 builders with vetted experts individually or as Collectives while preserving confidentiality.

Problem Statement
- Leak risk – Sharing alpha too early threatens edge & IP.
- Finding partners / experts – Cold outreach yields low success; assembling multi-disciplinary help is hard.
- Credibility gap – Lack of on-chain reputation / credentials makes vetting advisors guesswork.

Our Solution
- Encrypted project brief vaults & ROFL(Oasis.net) confidential scoring keep IP safe while surfacing the best talent match.
- Soul-bound reputation badges and escrowed payments align incentives and filter noise.
- Hats Protocol enables flexible, on-chain collectives and jury to curate, advise, fund and arbitrate transparently.
